name: hbfd_rly_624_sn_fc_f3

pin_regs.reason: F1 relay = ONE register stage at the pins by definition: i is captured by the stage register, o leaves it through the matched forwarding buffer; a pin register would add a cycle per hop and break the clk_out / o driver match (DIE-CLOCK F1)

structural_change: F1 forwarded-clock FORK variant (DIE-CLOCK rule: fork = relay tile with 3 branches, each with its own kept clk_out<k> buffer off the CTS tree + matched o<k> buffers on its face); same ot_hbm_rly stage; faces S: ['i', 2], N: [0, 1]; outline 218.16 x 21.6 um; ff3: stage register replicated per branch (ot_hbm_rly_fcfr: ff1/ff2 native launch 236-307 ps with one flop driving all branch groups)

job.purpose: HBM die F1 forwarded-clock fork relay hbfd_rly_624_SN_fc_f3: register on clk_in, 3 branches (clk_out<k> = one kept BUFx12f from the clk_in root, o<k> through the same cell beside it); 218.16 x 21.6 um, M5 cap

hold_budget_reason: F1 forwarded-clock relay: the boundary is a forwarded hop (clk_out<k> beside o<k>, DIE-CLOCK F1) timed by fcf_clock.tcl min separations 85/55 ps; the pins ARE the stage register (pin_regs opt-out), no inhold/outhold pads
